title: Luminous Core UI for M. U. T.
description: Add's a Simple change to the GUI/UI of Workstation Tables. That is Available on All More Useful Tables mods
body: Hello, Welcome to Luminous Core UI GUI Style for More Useful Tables. we sincerely hope that you will enjoy this resource pack for More Useful Tables. We have planned this a while back, but in doing so we had to change the GUI of the block to work. so make sure u use v3.0.0 Beta 2 and above to work cause we change it there. make sure to check the discord. see u soon for more updates
